title: Alien bodies studied in secret by biologists

tellings.quote: I know now that we have bodies here that we have biologists have studied here and that those studies are ended.
genetics studies or the uh studies that have been done on tissue of these beings that have been recovered. Uh I think that has been done.
tellings.difference: Salas speaks of tissue and genetics studies, as an impression he heard second hand, and does not say the studies have ended.
tellings.link_reason: Both are general claims that the bodies of recovered beings have been studied biologically in secret.

plain: The claim is that the United States holds the bodies of non-human beings, and that biologists have studied them in secret. The author Whitley Strieber, who says he has met such beings, states it flatly without naming a source: "we have bodies here that ... biologists have studied here and that those studies are ended." A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas gives it as an impression he picked up second hand, speaking of genetic studies on tissue from recovered beings, and he does not say the work has stopped. If true, it would mean the government has physical proof of other beings.
